description: Record money received against a chased invoice, in whole MINOR units: a part payment lowers what is still chased, a payment that covers the balance closes the ladder and frees the free-tier slot. Returns the outstanding amount.

amount_minor.description: What was received, in whole minor units

date.description: The date the money arrived, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

invoice.description: The chased invoice: its id (DUN-2026-0001) or its invoice reference

note.description: How it was paid, e.g. Bank transfer, or what it was against

name: payment_record
title: Record a payment received
